title: Projector Shadow
description: A vintage film projector mounted on a red curtained wall casts a bright beam of light across a decaying room, creating the silhouette of a person on a torn, painted wall. In the foreground, a single black dress shoe sits on a concrete floor with a small pool of blood beside it, while film reels hang nearby and smoke drifts through the light.
prompt: A dramatic surreal scene showing an old film projector mounted on a rich red velvet curtain casting a strong beam of light that creates the sharp shadow silhouette of a person on a crumbling wall covered in torn colorful abstract painting. A single black leather dress shoe rests on a dirty concrete floor with a small pool of blood nearby, smoke drifts through the light beam, hanging film reels on the left, moody cinematic lighting, painted in realistic yet painterly style
